title: 8 Best Websites for Design Inspiration and Trends in 2026
description: Eight sites worth returning to when the ideas run out, each one opened and checked. What each is good for, and which to use at which stage of a project.

blocks.v: Insights
Before diving into the specific websites, it's important to understand the value of these platforms:

v: Continuous inspiration: Regular visits to these sites can help overcome creative blocks and provide fresh ideas for projects.
Trend awareness: These platforms showcase cutting-edge designs, helping you stay current with industry trends.
Skill development: Observing high-quality work can inspire you to learn new techniques and improve your craft.
Community engagement: Many of these sites offer opportunities to connect with fellow creatives, fostering collaboration and growth.
Diverse perspectives: Each platform has its unique focus, offering a wide range of design styles and approaches.

blocks.v: Now, let's explore the 8 must-visit websites that can elevate your creative process and keep you at the forefront of design trends.
8 Must-Visit and Best Websites for Design Inspiration
Awwwards
Awwwards is a prestigious platform that recognizes and promotes the best of web design and development. It serves as a hub for cutting-edge digital experiences and innovative web solutions.
Pros:

v: Curated selection of high-quality websites
Scoring system based on design, usability, creativity, and content
Regular awards (Site of the Day, Month, Year) to highlight exceptional work
Comprehensive filtering options for specific inspiration needs
Educational resources and industry insights

blocks.v: Dark.design
Dark.design is a specialized platform showcasing outstanding examples of dark mode designs across various digital products and websites.
Pros:

v: Focused collection of dark mode interfaces
Inspiration for creating visually appealing and eye-friendly designs
Highlights innovative approaches to color schemes and contrast
Helps designers adapt to the growing trend of dark mode preferences
Provides insights into accessibility considerations for low-light interfaces

blocks.v: Behance
Behance, owned by Adobe, is a leading platform for showcasing and discovering creative work across various disciplines.
Pros:

v: Diverse range of creative projects, from graphic design to photography
Robust community features for feedback and collaboration
Integration with Adobe Creative Cloud for seamless workflow
Opportunity to gain exposure and connect with potential clients
Curated galleries and featured projects for quick inspiration

blocks.v: Dribbble
Dribbble is a community-driven platform where designers share small screenshots or "shots" of their work, works-in-progress, and other projects.
Pros:

v: Quick visual inspiration from a wide range of design disciplines
Active community with opportunities for feedback and networking
Job board for design professionals
"Playoffs" feature encouraging creative iterations and collaborations
Easy-to-use interface for browsing and discovering new work

blocks.v: Collect UI
Collect UI is a platform that aggregates and curates daily UI design inspiration from various sources.
Pros:

v: Daily updates with fresh UI design examples
Focused on specific UI elements and patterns
Easy navigation through categories like buttons, forms, and landing pages
Provides direct links to original sources for deeper exploration
Helps designers stay current with UI trends and best practices

blocks.v: UX Archive
UX Archive is a unique resource that focuses on user flows and interactions within mobile applications.
Pros:

v: In-depth look at user experience patterns in popular apps
Organized by specific tasks (e.g., onboarding, search, checkout)
Helps designers understand and improve common user journeys
Valuable resource for mobile app designers and UX professionals
Provides context and rationale behind UX decisions

blocks.v: Land Book
Land Book is a gallery showcasing beautiful landing pages from various industries and styles.
Pros:

v: Curated collection of high-quality landing page designs
Inspiration for creating impactful first impressions
Diverse range of industries and design approaches
Helps designers understand effective conversion-oriented design
Regular updates with fresh examples

blocks.v: App Motion
App Motion is a platform dedicated to showcasing innovative mobile app animations and interactions.
Pros:

v: Focused on the dynamic aspects of mobile app design
Inspiration for creating engaging and intuitive user experiences
Demonstrates creative ways to enhance app functionality through motion
Helps designers stay current with animation trends in mobile design
Often includes explanations or breakdowns of complex animations

blocks.v: FAQs

1. How often should I visit these websites for inspiration? It's beneficial to check these sites regularly, perhaps weekly or bi-weekly, to stay current with trends and maintain a fresh perspective on your work.
2. Can I submit my own work to these platforms? Many of these platforms, such as Awwwards, Behance, and Dribbble, allow designers to submit their work for consideration and showcase.

3. Are these websites only for web and app designers? While many focus on digital design, platforms like Behance cater to a wide range of creative disciplines, making them valuable for various types of designers and artists.

4. How can I make the most of these inspiration websites? Create collections or boards of your favorite designs, analyze why certain designs appeal to you, and try to incorporate new techniques or styles into your own work.
5. Are there any paid features on these websites? Some platforms offer premium features or memberships that provide additional resources, job opportunities, or enhanced showcasing options.

By regularly visiting and engaging with these 8 websites, you'll be well-equipped to spark your creativity, stay ahead of design trends, and continually improve your craft. Remember, the key is not just to observe but to analyze, learn, and apply these inspirations to your own unique projects and style.
Every tool and link in this article was opened and checked on 1 October 2026.
